messages:
alex: Kicking off staged rollout for web-inference-service v3.4.3-canary -> 15% traffic in eu-west-1. Change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. Please watch latency, errors, and any kvcache churn. Ping @pri for metrics.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: web-inference-service v3.4.3-canary -> 15% (eu-west-1). Details: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollouts/1823344556

pri: Watching dashboards now. I'll post p50/p95/p99 and 5xx snapshots at :30 and :45.

jordan: Noted — seeing a couple hosts with higher KV cache miss rate during warmup, p50 up ~60ms -> 90ms briefly. No error spike yet.

sam: Hit 15% at 23:15. No 5xx surge in the app logs, but tail latency (p99) ~1.2s on node eu-west-1-12. Pulling GC and thread dumps.

pri: Loading traces — a subset shows requests taking the re-quantization path and CPU climbing. Tagging @eng-runtime for triage.

eng-runtime-bot: Alert: node eu-west-1-12 observed kvcache-oom x2 within 10m. Autoscaler activity: scale-up triggered. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/kvcache-oom

alex: OK hold traffic. Rolling back to 5% and pinning stable version v3.4.2-prod for now. @deploy-bot please execute.

alex: Runbook rollback command:```
/deploy traffic set --service web-inference-service --region eu-west-1 --percent 5 --pin v3.4.2-prod
```

deploy-bot: Executing traffic change: web-inference-service: 15% -> 5% (eu-west-1). Pinned v3.4.2-prod for 10m. Rollout URL: https://deploys.redwood/internal/rollouts/1823344556/status

sam: Confirming rollback complete at 23:23 UTC. No new 5xx since change.

jordan: Grabbing heap and cpu flamegraphs now, will drop artifacts into the rollout runbook. Early look: eviction churn when many concurrent cold requests hit kvcache; eviction thrash causes re-quant fallbacks.

pri: Recommendation: re-run canary after applying two mitigations — (1) run a cache-prefill job to warm KV cache on affected hosts, (2) disable the experimental re-quant path for canary. Also add a temporary rate-limit on warmup endpoints to smooth intake.

alex: Agreed. Action items: 1) eng-runtime to add prefill job, 2) eng-platform to add a short-lived rate-limit and an explicit hold flag, 3) schedule a small re-run of canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC with 10% blast and prefill. Any objections?

eng-runtime-bot: Task created RT-3421: implement kvcache prefill job and instrumentation. Assigned to jordan.

jordan: I'll take RT-3421, ETA ~6h. I'll include a deterministic prefill script and a smoke-checker.

pri: I'll keep monitoring and stand by to manual-hold the rollout if anything else shows up. Leaving a watch for the change-window. :thumbsup:

alex: Closing loop for tonight. I'll update the release notes to mention the temporary pin and follow-up canary plan. Thanks everyone.
